programme.title: Perils of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: This well-named cliffhanger is fraught with adventure involving a mystery swordsman, a sensual swordswoman, an imperial assassin, a Ghost Mansion and more!

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This comedy contains dramatisations of some of the funniest and most surreal film gossips of director Li Han-Hsiang's 30 year career.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: In Wong Jing's first modern drama spiced up by three great kung fu choreographers, stars Ti Lung, Chen Hui Min, Wang Lung Wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu defy death.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays a beauty tricked into sacrificing herself for the good of the Chinese people. However, the truth is revealed too late.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: This fascinating, humorous box office smash captures a cross-section of Hong Kong society and their issues -- all crammed into a single tenement building.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: A kind Emperor lands himself in big trouble when he begins frequenting the gambling dens to learn what makes his subjects tick. Stars Anthony Lau, Wong Yue.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Sek Kin takes a refreshing break from his usual villain's role, playing a friendly ghost who befriends a young boy and helps him reunite his separated parents.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: This light-hearted 'a-go-go' romance depicts how three doctors pursue three beauties who play hard to get!

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting Pei plays a girl hiding from her father while working as a club singer in Japan. Then her father sends someone for her only for the man to fall in love with her.

programme.title: Whose Baby Is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Inoue Umetsugu's last Shaw film before his untimely death is a testament to the auteur's carefree comic talent.

programme.title: Love With the Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: Pauline Wong plays a pregnant student who marries a sympathetic, yet equally heartbroken, passer-by in Jamie Luk's directing debut.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Ding, a con woman swindles a diamond ring off a rich man, but when it ends up in another man's hands, she now has to get it back.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: This comedy centres on the residents of a females-only apartment who hail from different backgrounds and make money in varied ways.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The Mad Monk rushes around saving hawkers from crumbling walls and bullies, recovering stolen money and punishing a ruthless court official and his son.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: A nightclub owner (Peter Chen Ho) has his way with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Also starring Lily Ho, Chin Ping.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: According to this sex comedy, the true power behind China's many warlords were the prostitutes that these men would visit.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Director Lu Chun-ku leads Liu Yung, Liang Yun-hsin and 'Thundering Mantis,' Liang Chia-jen on a madcap quest filled with double crosses and triple plots.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: Regular Joes turn heroes to save their neighbourhood, when a local mobster decides to turn their local gossip spot into a gambling den!

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman

programme.title: Angel With the Iron Fists
programme.desc: After her father is killed by gangsters, a young woman seeks revenge plus bids to ensure that justice is served. Starring Lily Ho.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Three single females and the men they fall for think things are simple and blissful until the lasses' parents enter into the picture.

programme.title: The Proud Twins

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins

programme.title: The Lady Is the Boss

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
